Last Stand'' |writer=[[Alex Segura]]{{Marvel|url=articles/comics/the-final-battle-of-the-galactic-civil-war-three-new-star-wars-comic-series|text=The Final Battle of the Galactic Civil War is Told Across Three New 'Star Wars' Comic Series}} |penciller= |inker= |letterer= |colorist= |cover artist= |editor= |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |start date=[[December 25]], [[2024]]{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/116745/star_wars_battle_of_jakku_-_last_stand_2024_1|text=Star Wars: Battle of Jakku - Last Stand (2024) #1}} |end date=[[January 22]], [[2025]]{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/116748/star_wars_battle_of_jakku_-_last_stand_2024_4|text=Star Wars: Battle of Jakku - Last Stand (2024) #4}} |schedule= |format=Limited |issues=4 |timeline=[[5 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Battle of Jakku — Last Stand]]'' take place between the [[attack on Chandrila]] and [[Battle of Jakku]], which are both dated to [[5 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: Battle of Jakku — Last Stand''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] limited series, and the final of three limited series known as ''[[Star Wars: Battle of Jakku]]''. It is set between [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Episode VI Return of the Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Episode VII The Force Awakens'']] and tells the story of the [[Galactic Civil War]] after the [[Battle of Endor]] leading up to the [[Battle of Jakku]]. It was written by [[Alex Segura]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]].
